general_information.Syllabus Name: Introduction to Applied Cryptography_Mật mã ứng dụng
general_information.Description: In this course, students will learn basic security issues in computer communications, classical cryptographic algorithms, symmetric-key cryptography, public-key cryptography, authentication, and digital signatures. These topics should prove useful to those who are new to cybersecurity, and those with some experience.
general_information.StudentTasks: Student must get the certification of Introduction to Applied Cryptography specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination
general_information.Note: 1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100% 3. Student gets 0.25 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) >= 5 5. In the case: (5 > Final TE Score >=4) & (5 > Final PE Score >=4) & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) < 5, the student can choose to take the resit of both TE & PE OR just either TE or PE.
